sample_rule: three converter records, chosen by a fixed rule: a German member's text from the product records (P3/P3b), then a French and an Italian member's text from all three sets (P3, P3b, P5); within each, the record with the most v0.2 role fields filled from the documents (role_score: printed authors with a role, instrument function, printed submission date, language of every text, a per-question answer), then one where the language of a text differs from the source's tag (what language_of_text adds), then set order (p3, p3b, p5) and the lowest OPD id

document_parts.label: EXPLORATORY: rules written on these documents (no held-out test); the blind check of the detector is eval/parts (GUIDE_PARTS.md)
document_parts.detector: parts-1 (annex headings and attachment lists; aligned-column tables in pdftotext -layout; embedded images >= 2% of a page outside the letterhead and footer bands; scanned pages >= 85% of a page at >= 100 ppi)

qa_pairing.label: the P5 pairing rules (gegenprobe.qa.extract, rules route, no model; held-out P5: precision 0.83, recall 0.67) applied to every converter record; on P3 and P3b these documents were not part of P5's test, so their pairs are unscored

role_consistency.rules: R1 at most one sole_author; R2 sole_author excludes joint_author; R3 a person sole_author excludes a first_signatory; R4 joint_author excludes first_signatory and needs another joint author (gegenprobe.schema.role_consistency, from eval/p8/GUIDE_P8.md section 2)
role_consistency.repair: R2: every sole_author next to a joint_author becomes joint_author (GUIDE_P8: authors printed with equal standing, none designated first); names, pages, spans and rules unchanged

validated_records.sentence: 186 v0.2 records from 26 parliaments validate: the converter's 120 (105 cantonal and communal + 15 federal, 23 parliaments) and P8's 66 gold records (11 parliaments)
validated_records.note: n_affairs/n_parliaments at the top of this file count v0_2_all's sets p3, p3b, p5 and p8; this block adds the federal cell's records (fed_records.jsonl, validated here)

metadata_fill.label: POST HOC: fields OPD's own metadata holds, filled in the carrier layer (route metadata, source = the OPD record); no value replaced, no document read, no model
